newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to dip before move up to 130.36.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to dip before move up to 130.36.

text.p: June notionnel futures on the MATIF are bumping up against overbought levels and may slip near-term before a further move higher, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
David Wood, an independent technical analyst based near London, had a target of 130.32 to 130.36 on the contract.

"But in the short term it's overbought so you might be able to pick it up a bit lower, around 130.12, for a run up," he said. The contract's Relative Strength Index was at 69.9 percent on Tuesday, down from 70.8 percent on Monday. A reading above 70 percent on the RSI suggests contracts are overbought.
By 0758 GMT the June notionnel contract on the MATIF was down two basis points at 130.28.
Wood said a move above 130.36 would open up a target of 130.60, with the next big level at 131.00 to 131.02.
On the downside, support should come in at 130.12, then the psychological level of 130.00, Wood said.
Chase technical analyst Guenter Redeker was fairly bullish on the contract. He suggested taking profit on longs at 130.42/44 and increasing stops to 129.60.

"We would now expect a further break above (130.32) to target intra-day trendline resistance at 130.52/54 then the 130.60 barrier which also currently represents ascending channel resistance on daily charts," he said in a daily note to clients.
By 0757 GMT, June Pibor was unchanged at 96.50.
